notes.title: Version 7.1 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 7.1 Release Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added extended stat information for weapon 
[*]Added option descriptions for settings
[*]Upgraded Game Engine
[/list]

This version adds descriptions for option settings (some players were really confused) and improves the weapon additional stats. It previously showed only additional damage stats and now reload & fire rate is displayed as well.

Cheers!

notes.title: Project Lazarus Full Release!
notes.notes:
After many many patch cycles, we are leaving Early Access! Thank you for all those supported us throughout Early Access!

Also, Season 3 begins today and all leaderboards have been reset! Time to compete for the number one spot guys!

Enjoy!
